one_line_reason: Core product carries unsupported components and undocumented interfaces while remediation is not yet costed
Aging on-prem estate has no validated cloud exit plan and carries material dual-running exposure
Disaster recovery testing excludes the main customer platform and privileged access controls are inconsistent
Customer and product data are duplicated across platforms with limited lineage and uneven retention controls
Supplier concentration and near-term auto-renewals limit negotiating leverage
Several critical roles are single-person dependencies and contractor coverage is high across a 600-person business
Run cost is stable at about GBP 6m a year and broadly consistent with the size of the estate
